ns2:section.sectionText: Students in this class will write compose fiction creatively within forms, limits, and opportunities posed by works in which the reader controls the sequence. Our weekly classes will consist of reading, writing, discovering, analyzing, and distilling ideas from fantastic literary works composed and published in the past forty years. Each student will be required to compose a final creative work that demonstrates use of articulable techniques adapted from established hypertext fiction.
